The Fed — the U.S. central bank, which uses interest-rate policy as a lever to control the trajectory of inflation — may choose to increase its benchmark interest rate at upcoming policy meetings to rein in persistently high inflation, economists said. That benchmark rate has a direct impact on credit card rates and influences other borrowing costs, too.

The central bank aims for a long-term annual inflation target around 2%. Inflation has been above that target for more than five years. [...] Wednesday's CPI report "gives more support to the argument that the Fed is going to continue raising rates," Zandi said.

# Transportation Consumer Price Index – September 2026

Wednesday, October 14, 2026

Today, the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) released the change in the costs faced by consumers for transportation goods and services, from September 2025 to September 2026, as measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI). The annual change in CPI is a measure of inflation. [...] Gasoline (all types): +29.5%
 Airline Fare: +5.4%
 Motor vehicle maintenance and repair: +1.6%

The top three items dampening transportation’s contribution to inflation in September 2026 were:

 Motor vehicle insurance: -3.7%
 Used cars and trucks: -0.9%
 Other intercity (intercity bus, train, and ship fares): -0.1%
